rules.topic: Every Thermal Expansion dynamo (stirling, compression, magmatic, numismatic, lapidary, disenchantment, gourmand) exposes its base power as a server config value whose default and range come from its fuel manager; the same pattern holds for every machine in ThermalMachineConfig - so all Thermal rates quoted from the thermal_foundation rule file are config defaults, not constants

value.config: Base Power per dynamo and per machine

rules.topic: Thermal Expansion machine roster wired to managers (each with its own base power config): redstone furnace, sawmill, pulverizer, induction smelter, insolator, centrifuge, press, magmatic crucible, chiller, refinery, pyrolyzer, bottler, brewer, crystallizer, crafter and more; per-machine defaults live in ThermalCore managers (see the thermal_foundation rule file)

value.note: roster and config wiring only; values in ThermalCore

source_ref: last commit of the 11.0.1 window on branch 1.20.1 (parent of the 11.0.2 bump); the pack jar is the CI build 11.0.1.29 of that window (scheme=ci_build_number)
